question: Three numbers are in the ratio 17 ∶ 25 ∶ 66 and their HCF is 18. The smallest number among them is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of numbers = 17 : 25 : 66

Highest Common Factor (HCF) = 18

Smallest number corresponds to the smallest ratio part (17).

Smallest number = Smallest ratio part × HCF

Smallest number = 17 × 18 = 306

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of three numbers = 17 : 25 : 66

HCF of the numbers = 18

**Formula Used:**

Actual Number = Ratio Part × HCF

 
 1st Number (17x)
 
 
 2nd Number (25x)
 
 
 3rd Number (66x)
 
 Common Factor (x) = HCF = 18
 Ratio Visualization

Let the three numbers be 17x, 25x, and 66x.

Since HCF is the greatest common divisor for all the numbers, x represents the HCF.

⇒ x = 18

⇒ First number = 17 × 18 = 306

⇒ Second number = 25 × 18 = 450

⇒ Third number = 66 × 18 = 1188

⇒ Comparing 306, 450, and 1188, the smallest number is 306.

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF and Numbers in Ratio

If numbers are in ratio a : b : c and their HCF is h, then the numbers are ah, bh, and ch.

LCM of Numbers in Ratio

LCM of numbers having ratio a : b : c and HCF h is calculated as LCM(a, b, c) × h.

HCF × LCM Property

For two numbers A and B, A × B = HCF(A, B) × LCM(A, B). Note: This is not directly applicable to more than two numbers.</p
